scope: Bounded primary-source review for finite indistinguishable candidate worlds, linear observability/rank/nullspace checks, numerical SVD reporting, and finite query selection
execution_policy: Read-only source inspection; no implementation, browser run, deployment, external communication, human study, or Gate 9 work.

primary_sources.title: On the General Theory of Control Systems
primary_sources.publisher: Proceedings of the First IFAC Congress on Automatic Control
claims_used: Linear state-space observability is an observation/recovery property of the declared system and output history.
Observability and controllability are treated through computable linear-system structure and duality.
For a stacked linear observation map, rank identifies the observed directions while its nullspace contains state differences invisible to that map.
primary_sources.gate8_use: Model restricted intervention menus as observation maps; report rank/nullspace and separately enumerate finite candidate collisions; test a hidden-sign pair before and after a named revealing intervention.
primary_sources.limits: The paper concerns declared linear control models; it does not validate the Looking Glass geometry, rendering, finite fixtures, or any human interpretation.

primary_sources.title: Calculating the Singular Values and Pseudo-Inverse of a Matrix
primary_sources.publisher: Journal of the Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics Series B: Numerical Analysis
claims_used: A numerically stable SVD procedure exposes singular values and orthogonal singular vectors.
The pseudoinverse provides a practical least-squares solution and handles rank-deficient matrices.
When floating arithmetic is used, small singular values require an explicit numerical treatment rather than an unqualified exact-zero test.
primary_sources.gate8_use: Use SVD as an optional floating-point audit for stacked-map rank/nullspace and residual checks; the quarter-turn benchmark’s exact rational rank and candidate equality remain authoritative; retain raw values separately from rounded display values.
primary_sources.limits: The algorithmic paper does not prescribe this project’s tolerance, display format, candidate family, exact-rational arithmetic, or claim boundary.

primary_sources.title: Improving Generalization with Active Learning
claims_used: Active learning gives the learner control over which inputs receive information.
Selective sampling queries an oracle in a region of uncertainty and updates a version-space approximation.
Queries are useful when they target unresolved disagreement rather than arbitrary examples.
primary_sources.gate8_use: Freeze finite candidate worlds and intervention menu; choose a query that partitions surviving candidates; log pre/post candidate sets and label any outside-menu witness as out of scope.
primary_sources.limits: The paper studies binary concept learning and neural-network selective sampling; it is an algorithmic source, not a human-participant study or a proof for this benchmark’s geometry.

derived_gate8_requirements.requirement: Finite candidate equivalence under a finite menu
derived_gate8_requirements.design: For every candidate pair and every permitted intervention, store exact forward-map outputs and pairwise differences. Two candidates are equivalent under the menu only if their outputs are exactly equal for every permitted intervention. A floating-point tolerance may flag near-collisions for diagnosis, but pairwise within-tolerance comparisons must not be used to construct equivalence classes because the relation can be nontransitive.
derived_gate8_requirements.status: Application benchmark rule; not a result established by the sources.

derived_gate8_requirements.requirement: Rank/nullspace and finite separation are separate outcomes
derived_gate8_requirements.design: Report exact rational stacked-map rank/nullspace and pairwise candidate separation for the benchmark. If floating diagnostics are also used, report singular values, thresholded numerical rank, nullspace basis/residual, and conditioning separately. A finite family may separate despite a rank-deficient full state map, or remain colliding despite a poorly conditioned near-full-rank map.
derived_gate8_requirements.status: Application reporting rule; no human or arbitrary-image inference.

derived_gate8_requirements.requirement: Numerical and display precision are explicit
derived_gate8_requirements.design: Freeze the exact-equality rule, any diagnostic separation tolerance, and display rounding; report raw values and displayed values. If floating diagnostics are used, also report singular values and residuals and recheck near-threshold cases over a declared sensitivity range.
derived_gate8_requirements.status: Numerical audit requirement derived for this software benchmark.

derived_gate8_requirements.design: If a shifted-ball pair has exactly equal outputs across the allowed slice menu, record the pair as equivalent under that menu. Preserve near-equality as a diagnostic, and preserve any outside-menu separating intervention as a labeled witness without using it to upgrade the restricted-menu conclusion.
basis: Cohn, Atlas & Ladner 1994 query selection from uncertainty
derived_gate8_requirements.status: Scope boundary for the proposed Gate 8 benchmark.

limits: No source establishes that the Looking Glass instrument is correct, understandable, useful, or efficacious.
No human participants or human outcomes are present in this source pass.

Rank and nullspace results are conditional on the declared model, observations, correspondences, and exact arithmetic or explicitly reported numerical diagnostic rule; they do not establish reconstruction from arbitrary screenshots or a physical higher dimension.
A finite query can separate the frozen candidate family without proving uniqueness outside that family or outside the permitted intervention menu.
A display-rounding collision is an information loss in the displayed channel and must not be silently reported as a raw-model equality.
